tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// a pa ra yang dag shes kyi gzungs bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ yak+ṣa a pa ra bi shud+dha nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa yang dag shes kyi gzungs/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje/ ri rab ri'i rtse mo byang shar mtshams kyi pho brang*/ ngal gso ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ grangs med pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dang*/ gnod sbyin ngal bso ba dang*/ yang dag shes dang*/ nor bu bzang po dang*/ gang ba bzang po dang*/ dzam bha la la sogs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags nas 'khod do// de nas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po yang dag shes a pa ra'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ skul nor bu sna tshogs kyis brgyan te/ zla ba dang nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i sku rab tu bzhad pa stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje ga la ba der song ste/ bha ga wān la rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod pa byas nas 'di skad ces gsol to// bha ga wān/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na ma saṅgha ya/ na ma pra ma ya/ na ma in drā ye/ na mo tsa tu na ma/ ma bhe ra sha na ma/ tad+ya thā/ hi le hi le/ mi le mi le/ gu ri ma tu ri/ ma hā gha dha ri/ dha ra mi kye/ dha na dha/ khu khun dhe/ ha ha ha ha ha/ hi hi hi hi hi/ ho ho ho ho ho/ ha lo dam bhe/ tsa tsa tsa tsa/ tsi tsi tsi tsi/ tsu tsu tsu tsu/ sh+tsa na dha sh+yal/ shi gra shi gra/ un ti sa tha ti/ bha ga wān/ sing shing dhi lā ya swā hā/ 'di'i cho ga ni gnod sbyin yang dag shes kyi gzungs/ 'phang du cha bzhi lnga tsam yod pa la/ g.yas na dgra sta thogs pa/ g.yon ne'u le'i kha nas rin po che skyug pa thogs pa/

lus sgeg pa/ spyan dmar ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku mdog nag po gcig bris la de'i mdun na da kyil 'khor gru bzhi pa gcig byas la/ de'i phyogs bzhir bum pa bzhi/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi chab kyis bkang la bzhag go /byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ me tog rnams bkram mo// de'i mdun du thab gcig byas la/ der gzhan shing ngam/ shug pa'i me sbar la/ gzungs gong ma brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la bsreg blugs re re 'bul bas ni/ de'i dus su yang dag shes 'ong ste/ khyod ci 'dod ces zer du 'ong ngo*// sgrub pa po bdag la/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ rin po che thams cad dang*/ sa 'og gi gter dang*/ bar snang gi 'gro shes pa dang*/ mig gi mngon par shes pa dang*/ rna ba'i mngon par shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ sems can gyi yid 'phrog pa dang*/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad sman pa dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang*/ bsgo ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'phreng ba dang*/ rgyan la sogs pa ci 'dod pa thams cad gsol ba gdab bo// des thob par gyur te/ the tshom med do// de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po yang dag shes la legs so zhes bya ba byin no// phyi ma'i dus su bstan pa 'dzin cing skyong ba la nor med pa dang*/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus chung ba dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa'i yo byad med pa rnams la nor byin cig /ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ de nas 'khor thams cad dga' mgu yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// a pa ra yang dag shes kyi gzungs rdzogs so/// /sarba maṅga laṃ/ zhus dag /shu bhaṃ/// /
